```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Ingram'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND addr_state = 'Wisconsin'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(slope) AS min_slope
FROM (
  SELECT (ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, '32BF')) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  JOIN region_geom g
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, g.geom)
) AS slope_rast,
LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast) AS (
  path,
  geom,
  slope
)
WHERE slope IS NOT NULL;
```
